name: djdb-mcp
description: A read-oriented MCP server for a personal ListenBrainz-backed music library and recommender: status with library counts, preview recommendations (recording MBIDs and ISRCs only), and explain. Writes happen only through the djdb CLI (init, refresh). Zero-dependency Node stdio server. Not affiliated with or endorsed by ListenBrainz or MetaBrainz.

DJDB_PATH.title: Path to the main djdb.sqlite file
DJDB_PATH.description: Optional override of the main database path. Defaults to the path in config.json or the XDG data directory.
